name: hatchback
caption: A hatchback with a short hood, a tall cabin and a rear door. A cabin carries windows and a hood; four wheels attach below the body. Streamlined body panels keep an even thickness over the cabin. Overall width is 1.75 times depth; height is 0.50 times width. Parts follow functional positions. Continuous red, white, near black color regions distinguish the body and attachments. The front reveals functional parts; side and top views reveal depth, connections and layout.
